from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u092/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-1ef041b0.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 1]
    points.sort()
    if len(points) >= 2:
        dr = points[-1][0] - points[-2][0]
        dc = points[-1][1] - points[-2][1]
        r, c = points[-1]
        while 0 <= r + dr < len(out) and 0 <= c + dc < len(out[0]):
            r += dr
            c += dc
            out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(program_path), 'exec'), globals())
demo_in=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
for r,c in [(1,1),(3,3),(5,5)]: demo_in[r][c]=1
expected=[row[:] for row in demo_in]
for r,c in [(7,7),(9,9),(11,11),(13,13)]: expected[r][c]=2
print('demo reproduced:', transform(demo_in)==expected)
test=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
for r,c in [(0,0),(3,3),(6,6)]: test[r][c]=1
result=transform(test)
print(result)
print('saved:',program_path)
